# Baselayer

Baselayer is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Baselayer is a company that provides business identity verification, risk, and fraud solutions. They combine credit, identity, and fraud checks into one AI-powered system to boost auto-approvals and reduce manual reviews. Baselayer employs 34 people (+57.1% YoY, +12 people) and has an annual revenue of $540M. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with offices in Mesa and San Francisco. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Netherlands, and Sri Lanka.

## About

Baselayer empowers over 2,200 financial institutions and government agencies to trust the small and medium-sized businesses they serve. 

We use proprietary machine learning to search government records, the web, and private databases to answer questions about Compliance, Risk, or Fraud about any business in the United States.

Our solution suite includes tools for identity verification (Know Your Business), enhanced due diligence, fraud prevention, risk profiling, lien filing, and portfolio monitoring. Our platform also offers unique credit stacking capabilities and an advanced repeat fraud prevention system.

Baselayer is integrated into companies with over 30 million accounts, rating and verifying real-time applications.

results.text:
# Baselayer Biosciences

Baselayer Biosciences is a Biotechnology Research company. Baselayer Biosciences provides high-resolution protein dynamics analysis for epitope mapping, conformational stability, and binding interface localization. They support biologics programs from discovery through regulatory submission and are trusted by teams advancing therapies from discovery through regulatory submission. Baselayer Biosciences employs 3 people. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States.

## About

Baselayer Biosciences provides advanced protein analytics powered by state-of-the-art mass spectrometry. Our services include HDX-MS for higher-order structure and epitope mapping, intact mass and peptide mapping, native MS, glycan profiling, proteomics, and developability and comparability assessments for biologics.

All work is performed in the U.S. on industry-leading high-resolution mass spectrometry platforms, with workflows validated to retain significantly more deuterium than competing approaches. Our PhD-level scientists deliver expert interpretation and direct support, trusted by leading biopharma partners for frontier applications, from membrane proteins to complex sera.

We combine rigor, speed, and clear communication to move your program forward—whether you need a single study or a long-term CRO partner. Expect fast turnarounds, data-driven reports that inform critical decisions, and collaboration that accelerates your path from discovery through IND and formulation.

(Services currently for research use only.)
